page.overview:
Who is Rose Crusaders?

The Rose Crusaders are the private unit led by C. Seto Rosenkreuz in Yu-Gi-Oh! Duelist of the Roses. They are his followers whom have gone to many different counties in his quest to summon the Card Guardian.

The Rose Crusaders were hired by Richard Slysheen of York to maintain a mystical barrier to keep Henry Tudor's forces out of Britain. When each is defeated by the Rose Duelist, they are forced to surrender their White Rose Card to them, and once they have collected all eight, the barrier deactivates. Henry Tudor then unites with the traitorous Pegasus Crawford to overthrow Richard Slysheen, though Seto instead moves to Stonehenge to perform the ritual to summon Manawyddan fab Llyr. After the Rose Duelists defeats Seto and Manawyddan, Seto flees England and the Rose Crusaders are never seen again.
